book.name: 1 YON
book.title: Aposel Yon bung xailongdi mala rangua riang hatuminga haringinamdi. Tauxu xailong mugamugangamga li ba, 1 Yon

content: Bagu Tibura murungang sibunoa makira axamang sabanga sibuna! Binabu Urana uxu kira ba garandi! Kira baing! Namua lipu titiamdi daxabia kira te, bing daxabia ina te.

Riagu mana, hatata tawa Urana garandi. Ne kimuya bagula tawa baru, hatata hatanga masok teguyu. Ne taxabia ba kimuya bungina Kristo owa masok saing goxoya ma, bagula tawa bila ina, namua na bagula tabagu sibuna.
Baing lipu gaxarea ta ragunga mana bila ba, bing libu lunoa wa sigixinga sibuna, bila Kristo wa sigixinga sibuna.
Lipu gaxarea dilibu kubolu diandi, didali Urana hanaunaungandi. Maxuna, kubolu diana bing kubolu hanaunaungang dalingam.
Axabia ba Kristo ma bu sisia kubolura diandi. Baing kubolu dian tela wa maluxu mana te.
Lipu gaxarea taga rangua Kristo bing libu kubolu diandiyu te. Lipu gaxarea libu kubolu diandiyu bagu Kristo te, saing xabia te xauna.
Garagu mana, labu ayunga lipu tela tuxu murak manggu tai. Lipu gaxarea libu kubolu maringindi, bing lipu kubolu maringinam, bila Kristo lipu kubolu maringinam.

Lipu gaxarea libu kubolu diandi, bing ina xaungadi yanamidinga lipuxinoa, namua na xaungadi yanamidinga libu kubolu diandi mugamugau sibuna ma. Namua naga Urana Garanoa sok, bu hanggalangia xaungadi yanamidinga oxatanoa.
Lipu gaxarea sok Urana garanoa bagula libu kubolu diandi muli te, namua na Urana kubolunoa wa maluxu mana. Binabu sanga ba libu kubolu diandi muli te, namua na Urana garanoa.

Baing taxabia ba lipu gaxarea Urana garandi xaung lipu gaxarea xaungadi yanamidinga garandi bila li: Lipu gaxarea libu kubolua maringin te bing Urana garanoa te. Baing lipu gaxarea murung sibuna mana riang hatuminga haringinama te bing Urana garanoa te xauna.
Murura Sibuna Makira
Ulega alungu muga bungina ahatum haringina ma hatata bing: Murura sibuna makira.
Labu tawa bila Kengu tai, lipua ba lipu dianoa lipuxinoa saing ung kixinginoa mati. Baing baruta ung mati? Namua na ing sibung kubolundi didoa, ne kixinginoa kubolundi dimaring.
Riagu hatuminga haringinam mana, nabu lipu titiamdi hauxading sibuna mang, bing labu ahixi manau tai.
Taxabia ba tadali matiyua takisi mala mana walingua, namua na murura sibuna mana riara hatuminga haringinamdi. Lipu gaxarea murung sibuna mana riang hatuminga haringinama te wauyu matia.
Lipu gaxarea hauxang sibuna mana riang hatuminga haringinama bing lipu ungingam. Baing axabia ba lipu gaxarea lipu ungingama xap walinga subingang teguama te.
Taxabia kubolu murunga sibuna bila li: Kristo yunga walinganoa bu hauli kira. Binabu maring ba kira tayunga walingaradi bu hauli riara hatuminga haringinamdi.
Ne nabu lipu tela xalingina saing bagu riang hatuminga haringinama raxap, ne usinga te, bing Urana murungang sibunoa wa maluxu mana baru? Tegu.
Garagu mana, kubolua taharua suxunguria ba murura sibuna, ing ganina sanga te. Tegu. Bing tahatanga ba haruangaradi maxuna saing murura sibuna mana kuboluadi dahaulidi.
Nabu talibu bila ba, bing bagula taxabia ba tahaxa daxanga maxunamia. Baing ina naga, bagula tali maxania xaung hatumingaradi duwa mosiu, memeyara te.
Heku hatumingaradi disu haruanga nakira, gamoradi duwa mosiu. Namua na Urana sabanga sibuna mana hatumingaradi, saing xabia axamang longgalo.
Riagu mana, nabu hatumingaradi disu haruanga nakira te, bing tawa haringina bungina tali Urana maxania.
Baing baraxing baraxinta taxusunga mana, bagula taxap, namua na tasu mana hanaunaungandi saing talibu kuboluadi yaha manadi.
Baing hanaunaunganoa bing: Tahatum haringina mana Garanoa yanoa Yesu Kristo, xaung murura sibuna makira bila hanaunau kira ba.
Lipu gaxarea disu mana hanaunaungandi, ditaga rangua, saing ina taga ranguadi xauna. Baing taxabia ba taga rangua kira bila li: Namua na sina Aningonoa nakira.
